selective_rendering.config.title: Selective Rendering
selective_rendering.config.mode.descript: Which blocks fade out. The first three only go by what is inside the regions, the next three by what is outside, and the last two by the list alone: listed means the blocks on the list, unlisted means everything else, and all means every block there.
How far the faded blocks go. At 100% they are gone entirely.
selective_rendering.config.wand.descript: The item that activates the in-world controls. Hold it in either hand to set corners and edit the block list with clicks.
selective_rendering.config.items.descrip: A block name such as minecraft:stone, a tag such as #minecraft:planks, or a name with states such as minecraft:glass[color=red].
selective_rendering.config.regions.descr: The areas that were boxed out, as x1,y1,z1:x2,y2,z2. What was clicked in the world shows up here, and what is typed here shows up in the world.
selective_rendering.message.yacl_missing: Selective Rendering: YetAnotherConfigLib is not installed, so the config screen cannot be opened.
selective_rendering.hint.region: %s + Left: add or remove the region
selective_rendering.hint.region_single: %s + Right: add or remove the block on its own
selective_rendering.hint.block_state: %s + Right: toggle the block with its states
selective_rendering.hint.move_corner: Alt + scroll: move the selected corner
